func:
local retention = 1000 * 60 * 5
local metrics = {"temperature", "co2", "humidity", "tvoc", "eco2"}

-- Table mapping each room_label to its specific sensor IDs (without the department prefix)
local rooms = {
    ["departmentA:AA1"]           = {"AA1-01", "AA1-02"},
    ["departmentA:AB1"]           = {"AB1-01"},
    ["departmentA:AB2"]           = {"AB2-01", "AB2-02"},
    ["departmentA:LA1"]           = {"LA1-01", "LA1-02"},
    ["departmentA:StanzaCulmone"] = {"StanzaCulmone"},
    ["departmentA:StanzaDocente"] = {"StanzaDocente"},
    ["departmentA:TeamLab"]       = {"TeamLab-01", "TeamLab-02"},
    ["departmentB:B1"]            = {"B1-01", "B1-03"},
    ["departmentB:LB1"]           = {"LB1-01"},
    ["departmentB:SalaRiunioni"]  = {"SalaRiunioni"}
}

-- Iterate through the configuration table and create the time series keys
for room_label, sensors in pairs(rooms) do
    for _, sensor_id in ipairs(sensors) do
        for _, metric in ipairs(metrics) do
            -- Genera la chiave nel formato richiesto: stanza:sensore:metrica
            local key = room_label .. ":" .. sensor_id .. ":" .. metric
            redis.call("TS.CREATE", key, "RETENTION", retention, "LABELS", "room", room_label, "type", metric)
        end
    end
end

redis.call("TS.CREATE", "departmentA:StanzaCulmone:StanzaCulmone:people_count", "RETENTION", retention, "LABELS", "room", "departmentA:StanzaCulmone", "type", "people_count")

return "OK"

name: Append Telemetry & Fetch Snapshot
func:
local room_name = KEYS[1]
local params = cjson.decode(ARGV[1])

-- Shift ARGV array to remove the JSON string
table.remove(ARGV, 1)
if #ARGV > 0 then
    redis.call('TS.MADD', unpack(ARGV))
end

-- adds a TTL to the iot metrics so that if the sensor don't responde,
-- the metric does't match the real world
local ttl = 300 -- 5 * 60 seconds
redis.call("HEXPIRE", room_name, ttl, "FIELDS", #params, unpack(params))

-- Get current time in milliseconds
local t = redis.call('TIME')
local current_time = tonumber(t[1]) * 1000 + math.floor(tonumber(t[2]) / 1000)

local current_snapshot = redis.call("HGETALL", room_name)
local all_ts_results = {}

for i, param_name in ipairs(params) do    
    local config_key = "config:param:" .. param_name
    
    local config = redis.call('HMGET', config_key, 'agg_type', 'bucket_ms')
    local agg_type = config[1] or 'avg'
    local bucket_ms = tonumber(config[2] or '60000')
    
    -- Look backwards in time to capture the bucket, up to right now
    local from_time = current_time - bucket_ms
    local to_time = current_time + 1000 -- 1 second buffer to ensure we catch the MADD

    local filter_room = 'room=' .. room_name
    local filter_param = 'type=' .. param_name

    -- TS.MRANGE senza aggregazione (estrae i raw data)
    local result = redis.call(
        'TS.MRANGE', 
        from_time, 
        to_time, 
        'FILTER', filter_room, filter_param
    )
    
    -- Aggiungiamo anche agg_type all'output in modo che Node-RED sappia cosa fare
    table.insert(all_ts_results, {param_name, result, agg_type})
end

return {current_snapshot, all_ts_results}

name: update TTL
func:
local room_name = KEYS[1]
local params = cjson.decode(ARGV[1])

local ttl = 300 -- 5 * 60 seconds

if #params == 0 then
    return nil
end

-- if an attribute is updated with hset the ttl is removed
-- so here it is re-applied
local hexpire = redis.call("HEXPIRE", room_name, ttl, "FIELDS", #params, unpack(params))

return hexpire

Fetch all configs
func:
local keys = redis.call('KEYS', 'config:param:*')
local config = {}
for i, k in ipairs(keys) do
    local sensor = string.gsub(k, 'config:param:', '')
    local hash = redis.call('HGETALL', k)
    local obj = {}
    for j=1, #hash, 2 do
        obj[hash[j]] = hash[j+1]
    end
    config[sensor] = obj
end
return cjson.encode(config)

-- Keys and arguments
local topic = KEYS[1]
local json_payload = ARGV[1]

-- Retrieve the dynamic retention value passed as the second argument
local retention_ms = tonumber(ARGV[2])

-- Get current time directly from the Redis server
-- TIME returns an array: [1] = seconds, [2] = microseconds
local server_time = redis.call('TIME')
local current_timestamp_ms = (tonumber(server_time[1]) * 1000) + math.floor(tonumber(server_time[2]) / 1000)

-- Calculate the cutoff timestamp dynamically based on the YAML configuration
local cutoff_timestamp_ms = current_timestamp_ms - retention_ms

-- 1. Insert the new data into the Priority Queue
redis.call('ZADD', topic, current_timestamp_ms, json_payload)

-- 2. Remove all elements older than the calculated cutoff
local removed_count = redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYSCORE', topic, '-inf', cutoff_timestamp_ms)

-- Return the number of removed elements
return removed_count
